chapter.heading: A Song of degrees of David.
chapter.v:
If it
had not been the LORD who was on our side, now may Israel say;

If it
had not been the LORD who was on our side, when men rose up against us:

Then they
had swallowed us up quick, when their wrath was kindled against us:

Then the
waters had overwhelmed us, the stream had gone over our soul:

Then the
proud waters had gone over our soul.

Blessed be
the LORD, who hath not given us as a prey to their teeth.

Our soul
is escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers: the snare is broken, and we are escaped.

Our help
is in the name of the LORD, who made heaven and earth.
